title: Lanternfall
master_goal: Autonomously build and verify a cohesive indie 2D action platformer: three traversable chapters, responsive movement with jump buffering and coyote time, a dash attack, enemies, collectible objectives, checkpoints, readable UI, original sound, pause, win/lose states and restart. Never claim a finished game from file creation alone. Engine import, gameplay assertions, complete keyboard-driven campaign traversal and a startup smoke test must pass; visual and human playtesting remain explicitly reported.
release_rule: Automated checks establish an engine-verified prototype, not commercial release readiness. Keep the visual/playtest checklist open until reviewed.
